scripts.text:
^FF0000-Warning Message-
- Wait for a minute !! -
- You have too many items -
- Not able to receive items. -
- Reduce the weight of body -
- Please try again. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000-警告信息-
- 请稍等！！-
- 您的物品栏已满 -
- 无法接收物品。-
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后重试。-^000000

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You're not a mature enough adventurer. You should be at least base level 100. So basically at least a third class.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你还不够成熟，冒险者。你至少需要达到基础等级100级。也就是说，至少是转职三次的职业。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
冒险者们！

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Did you bring all the Brigans I asked for?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你带齐了我要求的所有布里刊了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Haven't found 50 Brigan yet? Master says that it's such a simple task...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
还没找到50个布里刊吗？师父说这任务很简单...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The request list is ready. Do you want to start?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
任务列表已经准备好了。你要开始吗？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
{0}! You did a good job! There are more requests but reserve them for the other adventurers.
I do not think you are suitable to the request I can give. Please find other adventures.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
{0}！你做得很好！还有更多任务，但留给其他冒险者吧。
我觉得我不适合给你分配我能提供的任务。请寻找其他冒险任务。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I do not think you are suitable to the request I can give. Please find other adventures.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我觉得我不适合给你分配我能提供的任务。请寻找其他冒险任务。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
{0}! You did a good job! There are more requests but reserve them for the other adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
{0}！你做得很好！还有更多任务，但留给其他冒险者吧。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Show me proof that you're part of the Eden Group or I have no business with you.
I'm giving requests to base level ^FF0000100 - 110^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请出示你是乐园团成员的身份证明，否则我与你无生意可做。
我只向基础等级^FF0000100 - 110^000000的冒险者发布任务。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Wait a minute. I am making a request list. I just do not know which one I have to give to you. I am a good man.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请稍等。我正在制作任务列表。我只是不知道该给你哪一个。我是个好人。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The request is from ^FF0000somewhere else^000000 other than Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这个任务来自^FF0000其他地方^000000，而不是米德加尔特。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I've recently received several requests from clients that need the help of Adventurers just like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我最近收到了一些需要像你这样的冒险者帮助的客户请求。

scripts.text: I like requests!
scripts.translation: 我喜欢任务！

scripts.text: A boring quest... No thanks!
scripts.translation: 无聊的任务... 谢谢，不用了！

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You know that harder requests yield better rewards right?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你知道更困难的任务会有更好的奖励吗？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Actually, I can't just accept just any schmo off the street. My Master hates indecisive people.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
实际上，我不能随便接受任何路人。我的师父讨厌优柔寡断的人。

scripts.text: Who's your master?
scripts.translation: 你的师父是谁？

scripts.text: I am not indecisive!
scripts.translation: 我不优柔寡断！

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
That person standing next to me is my master... He came back after long journey of practice.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
站在我旁边的那个人就是我的师父... 他结束了漫长的修行，刚刚回来。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I understand you might	wonder why a Sura wants an Archbishop as a teacher...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我理解你可能会疑惑，为什么一个修罗会找主教当老师...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You think you're a veteran just because you've become a third class...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你以为自己转职到第三转就是老手了吗...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I know you're not exactly a novice but my Master thinks you're no different from one. In my opinion, You are a great adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我知道你并不是初心者，但在师父眼里，你和初心者没什么两样。不过在我看来，你是一位很棒的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
We need adventurers that are willing to help. Will you help us?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我们需要愿意提供帮助的冒险者。你愿意帮帮我们吗？

scripts.text: Ok, I'll help.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会帮忙。

scripts.text: I have no interest in helping you.
scripts.translation: 我对帮你们没兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
How do you know without doing it.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
不做你怎么知道呢？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
That is what an Adventurer does!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这就是冒险者该做的事！

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I would like to know if you are capable of doing a request. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我想看看你是否具备完成委托的能力。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Collect 50 ^ff0000Brigan.^000000 It is a simple and complicated test.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
收集50个^ff0000布里刊^000000。这是一个简单又复杂的测试。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It is easy to find from monsters at Turtle Island or at Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
在海龟岛或格拉斯特海姆的魔物身上很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Lets do the real request after clearing the simple one.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
完成这个简单的测试后，我们再开始真正的委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I do not need to count one by one. This request is for selecting the best adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我不需要一个个去数。这个委托是为了选拔最优秀的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Don't be upset because Master is ultimately responsible if an Adventurer gets injured during a request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
别因为师父对冒险者在执行委托期间受伤负有最终责任而感到沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Master decided that adventurer's safety is important because lots of new requests are dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
师父认为冒险者的安全至关重要，因为许多新的委托都很危险。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I hope you didn't peek. The Assessment for your capability of standard requests is almost done.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
希望你没有偷看。对你执行标准委托能力的评估快结束了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
No time to make ^ff0000The badge of advanced Eden Group.^000000
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
没时间制作^ff0000乐园团高级徽章^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
^ff0000Time is money novice!^000000
I think that's what a true master would sound like right?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
^ff0000时间就是金钱，初心者！^000000
我想，这才是真正的师父会说的话，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
{0} will make a request list for you so go talk to my Master now and show your respects.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
{0}会为你制作委托清单，所以请现在去见我的师父，向他行礼致意。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please hurry up! We need a real adventurer to perform the request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请快点！我们需要一位真正的冒险者来执行委托。

scripts.text: Hunting Quests
scripts.translation: 狩猎委托

scripts.text: Inquire regards
scripts.translation: 咨询详情

scripts.text: Show kindness pass
scripts.translation: 出示善意通行证

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You don't need to take all requests at once. Choose a request area that suits your particular skills. One that enables you to perform the request and enjoy the trip at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你不需要一次性接取所有委托。请选择一个适合你技能的委托区域。既能执行委托，又能享受旅途，一举两得。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I am busy but clearing a lot of requests {0} I appreciate it. Lets see. I got some good food from an adventurer that he received during a request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我很忙，但能处理这么多委托，{0}我很感激。让我看看。有位冒险者在执行委托时收到了一些好吃的食物。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It is tough work but also fun to with master right {0}?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
虽然工作辛苦，但和师父在一起也很开心，对吧 {0}？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Did you bring the kindness pass?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你带善意通行证了吗？

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
We are so busy taking requests that need to be taken care of. It is my first time handling so much pressure.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我们忙着接取需要处理的委托。这是我第一次承受这么大的压力。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I thought Eden Group was busy but I could not imagine it is this much. I should do more as an adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我以为乐园团已经很忙了，但没想到会这么忙。作为冒险者，我应该做更多！

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I wish I could have a glass of fresh fruit juice...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我真想喝一杯新鲜果汁...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Adventurers sometimes bring special things or trophies from where they visited for a request. It is very good!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
冒险者有时会从执行委托的地方带回特别的物品或战利品。这非常好！

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
If there is something good {0} I will try to give you a couple things. I am not sure if there will be enough to give because of so many adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果有好东西 {0} 我会试着给你一些。因为冒险者很多，我不确定是否足够分发。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Handling documents must be difficult. It's so much easier to just be out in the field.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
处理文件一定很困难。在外面跑业务要轻松多了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I will let you know if there is something good.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果有好东西，我会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Are you get used to the requests? It is weird that I am guiding adventurers instead of taking requests myself.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你习惯这些委托了吗？很奇怪，我在指导冒险者，而不是自己去接委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It will be good if you clear one at a time after receiving all the requests from Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果你从格拉斯特海姆接取了所有委托，最好一次完成一个。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Cheer up! {0} I'm not sure if he thinks of you as his pupil. He is just out of control.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
振作起来！{0}我不确定他是否把你视为徒弟。他只是控制不住自己。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
There are a lot of presents coming in whenever the requests are done efficiently. Here, take this as a prize.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
只要委托高效完成，就会有很多礼物送进来。拿着，这是给你的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I am sorry but I am a little bit busy. Can we talk later?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
抱歉，我现在有点忙。
我们稍后再谈好吗？

scripts.text: Glastheim related request
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆相关委托

scripts.text: Ash Vacuum related request
scripts.translation: 阿什吸尘器相关委托

scripts.text: Ice Dungeon related request
scripts.translation: 冰之地下城相关委托

scripts.text: Magma Dungeon related request
scripts.translation: 熔岩地下城相关委托

scripts.text: Other requests
scripts.translation: 其他委托

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Here are the requests from the Glastheim area.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这是来自格拉斯特海姆地区的委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
There are many requests coming through from the Midgard Expedition.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
来自米德加尔特远征的委托很多。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
There are many request near or in the Ice Dungeon in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
拉赫的冰之地下城附近有很多委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
There is a request for monster hunts in Magma Dungeon. ^DA26DAPretty girl wanderer^000000 is requesting this from Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
有一个在熔岩地下城狩猎魔物的委托。
^DA26DA漂亮的浪姬舞者^000000正在克魔岛发布此委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Here is a list of other requests from all over Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这是来自米德加尔特各地的其他委托列表。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text: Carat Hunting
scripts.translation: 狩猎卡拉特小丑

scripts.text: Arclouse Hunting
scripts.translation: 狩猎阿库劳斯

scripts.text: Anolian Hunting
scripts.translation: 狩猎虎蜥人

scripts.text: Sting Hunting
scripts.translation: 狩猎史汀

scripts.text: Majoruros Hunting
scripts.translation: 狩猎狂暴米诺斯

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This request is to clear ^0000FF30^000000 ^FF0000Carat^000000 inside of Glastheim castle's first floor.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这个委托是清除格拉斯特海姆城堡一楼的^0000FF30^000000 ^FF0000卡拉特小丑^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Visiting to scary old castle must be tough. I am sure it would be a good experience for me someday.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
去那种阴森的老城堡一定很艰难吧。
我相信总有一天我会获得不错的体验。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This request is from a merchant from Morocc who is somehow losing business from these monsters in Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这个委托来自莫洛克的商人，他因为格拉斯特海姆的这些魔物而生意受损。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000022 Arclouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请清除^FF000022只阿库劳斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Do you know there are beans used as food here in Midgard? When an Arclouse rolls, it resembles a bean.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你知道在米德加尔特，豆子是可以作为食物的吗？阿库劳斯滚动起来的样子很像豆子。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
A monk is on a pilgrimage and seeks protection against some alligator-like creatures.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
有一位武僧正在朝圣，他需要保护，以抵御那些鳄鱼人。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You fared well with this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你很好地完成了这个委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Glastheim seems to be a good sacred place not only to adventurers but also to monks. I have no idea what really attracts them there.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
格拉斯特海姆似乎不仅对冒险者，对武僧来说也是一处圣地。我不知道究竟是什么吸引他们前往那里。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
There are many Sting monsters in the underground waterway and underground cave so it will be easy to clear.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
地下水道和地下洞穴里有许多史汀，所以清除起来应该很容易。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Visiting to filthy and smelly underground must be tough. It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
去那种肮脏又恶臭的地下一定很艰难吧。
这对你来说会是一次不错的体验。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Have you heard about a monk's pilgrimage? There are so many Stings in the underground waterway and cave so they disturb the peaceful monks.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你听说过武僧的朝圣吗？地下水道和洞穴里有太多的史汀，它们打扰了正在修行的武僧。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I wonder what the reason is behind these monk pilgrimages and why they keep doing it... There must be a hidden reason.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我想知道这些武僧朝圣背后的原因，以及他们为什么坚持这样做...一定有什么隐藏的理由。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Visiting for a long pilgrimage must be tiring.
It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
进行漫长的朝圣一定很累吧。
这对你来说会是一次不错的体验。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The monk's pilgrimage destination is on the 2nd floor of the Glastheim castle underground cave. It is not an easy journey but will be a good experience.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
武僧的朝圣目的地在格拉斯特海姆城堡地下洞穴的二楼。这是一段不轻松的旅程，但会是一次不错的体验。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. It is important that you rest for a while. There will always be a requests waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一个委托。休息一会儿很重要。总会有新的委托在等着你。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Please take a rest. There will always be a request for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一个委托。请休息一下。总会有新的委托等着你。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. There will always be a request waiting for.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一个委托。冒险很重要，但休息也很重要。总会有新的委托在等着你。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. Pilgrimage will be continued so there will be another request again.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一个委托。冒险很重要，但休息也很重要。朝圣还会继续，所以还会有新的委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've completed the request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
完成委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Eden Group is aware that this is not a great reason but a request is a request. So please clear ^FF000030 Carat^000000 monsters inside of Glastheim castle.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
乐园团知道这不是一个很好的理由，但委托就是委托。所以请清除格拉斯特海姆城堡内的^FF000030只卡拉特小丑^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Eden Group Headquarters wants to investigate the Arclouse as a possible mascot.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
乐园团总部想要调查阿库劳斯，看它是否适合作为吉祥物。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000022 Arclouse^000000.
[Gelkah]
That is too bad. It was an interesting request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请清除^FF000022只阿库劳斯^000000。
[盖尔卡]
真遗憾。这是一个有趣的委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000022 Arclouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请清除^FF000022只阿库劳斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Anyways, this request is to clear out Anolians in underground waterway to make way for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
总之，这个委托是清除地下水道中的虎蜥人，为安全的朝圣开辟道路。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]

[Gelkah]
A Pilgrimage from the monastery to the underground waterway is a journey. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Anolian^000000 in the Glastheim sewer for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
从修道院到地下水道的朝圣是一段旅程。委托内容是清除格拉斯特海姆下水道中的^FF000030只虎蜥人^000000，以确保朝圣安全。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The request is to clear ^FF000030 Sting^000000 in underground waterway and underground cave for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
委托内容是清除地下水道和地下洞穴中的^FF000030只史汀^000000，以确保朝圣安全。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Master accepted this request because he respects those monks. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Sting^000000 monsters in underground waterway for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
师父接受了这个委托，因为他尊敬那些武僧。委托内容是清除地下水道中的^FF000030只史汀^000000，以确保朝圣安全。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I used to take care of the request but I am worried. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Majoruros^000000 from the 2nd floor of the underground cave.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我原本负责处理这个委托，但我有些担心。委托内容是清除地下洞穴第二层的^FF000030只狂暴米诺斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Majoururos is not easy to hunt so be careful. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Majoruros^000000 in the underground cave second floor.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
狂暴米诺斯并不容易讨伐，请小心。委托内容是清除地下洞穴第二层的^FF000030只狂暴米诺斯^000000。

scripts.text: Hunting Quests
scripts.translation: 狩猎委托

scripts.text: Trauma
scripts.translation: 创伤

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Outbound space is mysterious.. Monsters are unique.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
外出空间很神秘...魔物也很独特。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Visiting the Ash Vacuum must be tough.
It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
去阿什真空地带一定很艰难吧。
这对你来说会是一次很好的体验。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Pinguicula is one of the first monsters that adventurers encounter when they step into the Ash Vacuum. They expect us to reduce monsters around the Expedition Camp.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
捕虫堇是冒险者进入阿什真空地带时最先遇到的魔物之一。他们希望我们减少远征营地周围的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. Please take a rest. There will always be a request for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一个委托。冒险很重要，但休息也很重要。请休息一下。总会有适合你的委托。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This is an unusual request. Please clear ^FF000030 Pinguicula^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这是一个不寻常的委托。请清除^FF000030只捕虫堇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It is natural to have more accidents with new monsters. It is a common request. Please clear ^FF000030 Pinguicula^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
面对新魔物发生事故是很自然的。这是一个常见的委托。请清除^FF000030只捕虫堇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This is a strange request and a strange reason but we should accept it anyway.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这是一个奇怪的委托，理由也很奇怪，但我们还是应该接受它。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It must be very tough to do such a strange request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
执行如此奇怪的委托一定很艰难吧。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This is a very personal request. It is unusual but this request is from an adventurer who is friendly with Rohtert.. It is requested by Pretty Boy. Why did he write this?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这是一个非常私人的委托。虽然不寻常，但这是来自与罗特特友好的冒险者的请求。是漂亮男孩提出的。他为什么要写这个？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. Please take a rest. This request is not worth working so hard.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一个委托。冒险很重要，但休息也很重要。请休息一下。这个委托不值得这么辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Luciola Vespa^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请清除^FF000030只鲁修拉黄蜂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It is too personal that he got stung by a bee when he was young. It traumatized him so he can't travel to Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
他小时候被蜜蜂蜇过，这太私人了。这让他留下了创伤，所以他无法前往阿什真空地带。

scripts.text: Gelkah is staring at Rohtert.
scripts.translation: 盖尔卡正盯着罗特特看。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This seems to be a request for increased travelers to the new world. Please clear ^FF000030 Luciola Vespa^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这似乎是一个关于增加前往新世界的旅行者的委托。请清除^FF000030只鲁修拉黄蜂^000000。

scripts.text: Desert Wolf Hunting
scripts.translation: 沙漠之狼狩猎

scripts.text: Snowier Hunting
scripts.translation: 雪怪狩猎

scripts.text: Ice Titans...
scripts.translation: 寒冰巨人...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Have you read old books? That is about an adventurer who was fighting with big wolves and it ended up with a friendship. It's called Samba's with Wolves.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你读过旧书吗？那本书记述了一位冒险者与巨狼搏斗，最终结下友谊的故事。它叫《与狼共舞》。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Wasn't that cute?
It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
那不是很可爱吗？
这对你来说会是一次很好的体验。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The Ice cave is directly north of Rachel. The problem is that the Wolves frighten tourists when they are heading to see the Ice cave.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
冰洞位于拉赫的正北方。问题是，当游客前往参观冰洞时，狼群会吓到他们。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Rough breath, insecure eyes, freezing cold.. It is not easy request so get yourself warm.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
粗重的呼吸，不安的眼神，刺骨的寒冷...这是一个不容易的委托，请做好保暖准备。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Visiting the freezing ice dungeon must be tough.
It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
参观冰冷的冰洞一定很艰难。
这对你来说会是一次很好的体验。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
People who have been to ice dungeon say there are noisy monsters disturbing their visits. Please clear them if you can put up with it.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
去过冰洞的人说，那里有吵闹的魔物打扰他们的参观。如果你能忍受的话，请清除它们。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Ice Titan^000000 at the Ice cave.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请在冰洞清除^FF000030只寒冰巨人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Visiting that cold dark cave must be tough.
It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
参观那寒冷黑暗的洞穴一定很艰难。
这对你来说会是一次很好的体验。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Have you been to Ice cave north of Rachel? There are monsters called as Ice Titans deep in the dungeon. Scholars want to determine if they are golems or not.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你去过拉赫北方的冰洞吗？地牢深处有一种叫寒冰巨人的魔物。学者们想要确定它们是否是巨石怪。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一个委托。冒险很重要，但休息也很重要。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
A novel is a novel. Please clear ^FF000030 Desert Wolf^000000 near the entrance to the Ice dungeon in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
小说毕竟是小说。请在拉赫的冰洞入口附近清除^FF000030只沙漠之狼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It would be fun if we can talk and samba with wolves! Please clear ^FF000030 Desert Wolf^000000 near Ice dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果我们能和狼聊天、共舞，那该多有趣！请在冰洞附近清除^FF000030只沙漠之狼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Snowier^000000 on the second floor of Ice dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请在冰洞的第二层清除^FF000030只雪怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Snowier^000000 on the second floor of Ice dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请在冰洞的第二层清除^FF000030只雪怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The request is to reduce the number of them for the scholar's safety. Please clear ^FF000030 Ice Titan^000000 at the Ice cave.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
委托内容是减少它们的数量，以保障学者的安全。请在冰洞清除^FF000030只寒冰巨人^000000。

scripts.text: Nightmare Terror Hunting
scripts.translation: 七彩梦魇狩猎

scripts.text: Deleter Hunting
scripts.translation: 七彩地龙狩猎

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The memory of a girl is important ! Please clear ^FF000030 Nightmare Terror^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
女孩的记忆很重要！请清除^FF000030只七彩梦魇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Consider the memory of others. There is stil abeauty in the world. It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请体谅他人的感受。世界上依然存在着美好。
这对你来说将是一段不错的经历。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This request is from a client that is sad because the magma dungeon is full of monsters when she came back to return after breaking up with her lover. Apparently, she spent a lot of time with him there and wants some peace.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这项委托来自一位悲伤的客户。她和恋人分手后回到熔岩地下城，却发现那里魔物横行。
显然，她曾在那里度过许多时光，现在只想寻求片刻安宁。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Thanks for keeping memory.. but You should take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一项委托。谢谢你守护了这份记忆……
不过，你也该休息一下了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The memory of a girl is important! Please clear ^FF000030 Nightmare Terror^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
女孩的记忆很重要！请清除^FF000030只七彩梦魇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
A client showed a wonderful dance to a lover. One day, they were attacked from a Deleter while they are dancing in the magma dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
一位客户曾向恋人展示过精彩的舞蹈。有一天，当他们在熔岩地下城跳舞时，遭到了一只七彩地龙的袭击。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Eden Group protects love, justice and Midgard! hurrah!
It would be a good memory.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
乐园团守护着爱、正义与米德加尔特！万岁！
这将是一段美好的回忆。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Did you take enough time to cool down? Take enough rest.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你刚完成了一项委托。你花足够的时间冷静下来了吗？
请好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The attack ruined their dance and eventually their relationship because the guy blamed the girl for being attacked.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
那次袭击毁掉了他们的舞蹈，最终也毁掉了他们的关系，因为那个男人责怪女孩导致了被袭击。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Now she blames the Deleters so she has made this request. Please clear ^FF000030 Flying Deleter^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
现在她责怪那些七彩地龙，所以发布了这项委托。请清除^FF000030只飞行七彩地龙^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The attack ruined their dance and eventually their relationship because the guy blamed the girl for being attacked.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
那次袭击毁掉了他们的舞蹈，最终也毁掉了他们的关系，因为那个男人责怪女孩导致了被袭击。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Now she blames the Deleters so she has made this request. Please clear ^FF000030 Flying Deleter^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
现在她责怪那些七彩地龙，所以发布了这项委托。请清除^FF000030只飞行七彩地龙^000000。

scripts.text: Loli Ruri Hunting - Niflheim
scripts.translation: 萝莉·露莉狩猎 - 尼弗海姆

scripts.text: Medusa Hunting - Comodo
scripts.translation: 米杜沙狩猎 - 克魔岛

scripts.text: Anubis Hunting - Sphinx
scripts.translation: 安毕斯狩猎 - 斯芬克斯

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Eden Group is planning to send a notice that unmature adventurers are not sent to night time requests because it is too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
乐园团计划发布一份告示：不成熟的冒险者不被派往夜间委托，因为那太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Are you mentally wounded? I am happy that you're back safely.
It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你的精神受创了吗？很高兴你平安归来。
这对你来说将是一段不错的经历。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
A secret society requested the protection of the Eden Group from the Loli Ruris because they believe that they have mental powers.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
一个秘密组织请求乐园团保护他们免受萝莉·露莉的侵害，因为他们相信萝莉·露莉拥有精神力量。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I do not know why master likes this kind of request. He also used to say any request is a good request for an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我不知道师父为什么喜欢这种委托。他也常说，对冒险者来说，任何委托都是好委托……

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
How is Comodo beach? Take a look around instead of paying too much attention to the request.
It will be a good experience for sure.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
克魔岛的海滩怎么样？与其过分关注委托，不如四处看看。
这肯定会是一次不错的经历。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
This is a request from a hair designer in Alberta. He wants to know if the snakes on the Medusa's head are really snakes or fancy hair...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这是来自艾尔贝塔一位发型师的委托。他想知道米杜沙头上的蛇到底是真正的蛇，还是某种时尚发型……

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I shoud investigate about the client by myself but for now please clear ^FF000020 Anubis^000000 on the 4th floor of Sphinx dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我应该亲自调查这位客户，但现在请先在斯芬克斯地下城第四层清除^FF000020只安毕斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Sphinx dungeon is such a maze.
It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
斯芬克斯迷宫就像个迷宫一样复杂。
对你来说，这会是一次不错的历练。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
An anonymous client sent a request to help clear monsters in Sphinx dungeon because adventurers hardly visit Morocc anymore. The monsters seem to be running rampant there.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
一位匿名委托人请求我们清理斯芬克斯迷宫的魔物，因为现在很少有冒险者去穆拉了。那里的魔物似乎正在肆虐。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I think you should rest a bit. Even adventurers need their rest right?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我觉得你应该休息一下。即使是冒险者也需要休息，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
冒险很重要，但休息也很重要。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The request from Sphinx is done. Please take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
来自斯芬克斯的委托已经完成了。请好好休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I wonder why they are scheming this kind of ^FF0000nonsense^000000... makes me wonder if they even know anything about adventuring.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
真不知道他们为什么要策划这种^FF0000胡闹^000000...让人怀疑他们是否真的懂什么冒险。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
We should accept this simple request before we start getting even more nonsense ones. Please clear ^FF000030 Loli Ruri^000000 in Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我们应该先接受这个简单的委托，以免接下来出现更多胡闹的请求。请在尼弗海姆清理^FF000030只萝莉·露莉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
They said that they would heal Eden Group adventurers who are exhausted in exchange for the request but we're not sure they'll follow through.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
他们说会治愈乐园团中疲惫的冒险者作为交换，但我们不确定他们是否会兑现承诺。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
We should accept the simple request anyways. Please clear ^FF000030 Loli Ruri^000000 in Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
不管怎样，我们应该接受这个简单的委托。请在尼弗海姆清理^FF000030只萝莉·露莉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Medusa^000000 in the western cave of Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请在克魔岛西边的洞穴清理^FF000030只米杜沙^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Obviously they're snakes but who are we to stamp on this crazy guy's dreams right?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
那明显是蛇，但我们怎么能打击这个疯子的梦想呢？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
My master accepted this request simply because it was insane. Please clear ^FF000030 Medusa^000000 monster in the west cave of Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我的师父仅仅因为这件事很疯狂就接受了这个委托。请在克魔岛西边的洞穴清理^FF000030只米杜沙^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
清除完这个委托后请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000020 Anubis^000000 on the 4th floor of Sphinx dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请在斯芬克斯迷宫第四层清理^FF000020只安毕斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Oops I ate all? Okay just one left. Please drop by later!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
哎呀，我都吃光了？好吧，还剩一个。请稍后再来！

scripts.text: I hate that hot-tempered fool.
scripts.translation: 我讨厌那个脾气暴躁的家伙。

scripts.text: I want you to be the master.
scripts.translation: 我希望你能成为师父。

scripts.text: I would follow you to any battle.
scripts.translation: 我会追随你参加任何战斗。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I understand you. I got into a fight when I first met master in Mora village.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我理解你。我第一次在穆拉村庄见到师父时，还和他打了一架。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I'm not sure if I'm cut out for that job. Besides...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我不确定我是否适合那个职位。而且...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I am sorry to say this but I am the only pupil of master now and forever... He said ^FF0000I don't need an ugly female pupil^000000 but I still stick to him.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
很抱歉这么说，但我现在是师父唯一的弟子，也将永远是...他说^FF0000我不需要一个丑陋的女性弟子^000000，但我依然追随他。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Oh no... Please don't do that. I am sorry please keep it as a secret to a master. I was careless.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
哎呀...求求你别那样。对不起，请对师父保密。是我太不小心了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
He was almost crying when I first met him. It was difficult to pretend to lose to him. Please keep it a secret.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我第一次见到他时，他差点哭了。假装输给他其实很难。请帮我保密。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Good luck on the remained requests.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
祝你完成剩下的委托顺利。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Good luck on the remained request. ^FF0000Master says he has something to say to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
祝你完成剩下的委托顺利。^FF0000师父说有话想对你说。^000000

scripts.text: The ^FF0000kindness pass^000000?
Exchange pass for prizes.
scripts.translation: 用通行证兑换奖品

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I know it sounds childish. Right? The shape is just like the card we used to play when we were kids.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我知道这听起来很幼稚。对吧？它的形状就像我们小时候玩的那种卡片。

scripts.text: A card? What is it?
scripts.translation: 卡片？那是什么？

scripts.text: Uh, yeah those were fun...
scripts.translation: 呃，是啊，那些确实很有趣...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I am sorry... It must be popular only in our village. Throw, heat and let it fly it.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
抱歉...这东西大概只有我们村子里才流行。扔出去，加热，然后让它飞起来。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
As you see, master made it himself and put his picture on it. He used to travel aroung for looking for the paper material to make the card.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你看，这是师父亲手做的，上面还印着他的照片。他以前会四处旅行，寻找制作卡片用的纸张材料。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
If they were not filed properly, the request of looking for a paper will be included to the request list.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果纸张没有妥善归档，寻找纸张的委托就会出现在委托列表中。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
He is very kind even though he doesn't look like it. Master used it to give something to adventurers for their devotion.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
虽然他看起来不像，但他其实很善良。师父用这个来奖励那些尽心尽力的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Give the story about adventure or trophy by using 1,10,20 and 30 cards.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
使用1、10、20和30张卡片，可以讲述冒险故事或展示战利品。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
It will be agood experience if you listen to the story of adventurer. There are so much adventure that we heard from a master.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果你听一听冒险者的故事，那将是一段美好的经历。我们从师父那里听到了很多冒险故事。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
If you are matured enough not to need a request Make sure that you are not allowed to use a pass.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果你已经足够成熟，不需要委托了，请确保你被允许使用通行证。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
How do you want to use this pass?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你想怎么使用这张通行证？

scripts.text: Exchange for prizes
scripts.translation: 兑换奖品

scripts.text: Listen to a story and get EXP
scripts.translation: 听故事并获取经验值

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You can pick a trophy in this bag. Please do not be disappointed even if you picked up something you do not want. How many do you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你可以从这个袋子里挑选一个战利品。即使你挑到了不想要的东西，也请不要失望。你想兑换多少个？

scripts.text: Exchange kindness ^FF00001^000000 pass
scripts.translation: 兑换^FF00001^000000张善意通行证

scripts.text: Exchange kindness ^FF000010^000000 pass
scripts.translation: 兑换^FF000010^000000张善意通行证

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please give me a pass and put your hand in a bag to pick.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
请给我一张通行证，然后把手伸进袋子里挑选。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
^FF0000Kindness pass^000000 is insufficient.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
^FF0000善意通行证^000000不足。

scripts.text: browsing
scripts.translation: 浏览

scripts.text: You reach into the bag and grab ^0000FF{0} {1}^000000.

[Gelkah]
Make good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
好好利用它吧。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Ok, I've got a story for you in exchange for the kindness pass.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
好的，作为交换善意通行证，我有一个故事要讲给你听。

scripts.text: Give ^FF000010^000000 kindness pass
scripts.translation: 交出^FF000010^000000张善意通行证

scripts.text: Give ^FF000020^000000 kindness pass
scripts.translation: 交出^FF000020^000000张善意通行证

scripts.text: Give ^FF000030^000000 kindness pass
scripts.translation: 交出^FF000030^000000张善意通行证

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Have you seen the sunken ship near Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你见过艾尔贝塔附近的沉船吗？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
One time, master and I went to the cave west of Comodo and when we saw the Medusa monster...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
有一次，我和师父去了克魔岛西边的洞穴，当我们看到米杜沙魔物时...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I once got lost in a maze north of Prontera. I thought I was going in circles forever until I finally made it out.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
有一次我在普隆德拉北边的迷宫里迷路了。我以为我会永远转圈，直到最后终于走了出来。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Once I found a secret route to get to Jawaii... It's only for couples but some of us know how to get there still.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
有一次我发现了一条通往爪哇的秘密路线...那是只给情侣的，但我们中有些人知道怎么去。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
So one time, master was part of a guild called wing something... Chicken wing...?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
有一次，师父加入了一个叫翅膀什么的公会...鸡翅...？

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Have you been up to ^FF0000endless tower^000000? Master and I went there but only got to the 20th floor because his knee gave out while climbing...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你去过^FF0000无尽之塔^000000吗？我和师父去过那里，但只爬到了20层，因为他的膝盖在攀爬时疼得受不了...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Master's guild was dismissed at the Ash Vacuum because their guild master went missing after a battle with some Cornus monsters.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
师父的公会在阿什真空被解散了，因为他们的公会在与飞马魔物战斗后失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
[Gelkah]
Master started out as a popular support Monk at the Prontera monastery.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
师父最初是普隆德拉修道院的一位受欢迎的辅助武僧。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
scripts.translation: [盖尔卡]

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You don't have enough kindness passes.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你的善意通行证不足。

scripts.text: Master Rohter and I traveled deep into the ship and battled a monster known as ^FF0000Drake^000000. That day I was determined that I would be the best adventurer.
scripts.translation: 师父罗特和我深入船舱内部，与一只名为^FF0000海盗之王^000000的魔物战斗。那天，我下定决心要成为最强的冒险者。

scripts.text: Oh boy the look on his face was priceless!
scripts.translation: 天哪，他当时的表情简直太逗了！

scripts.text: Rumor has it that if you get lost in that maze you'll turn into one of the monsters there.
scripts.translation: 传闻说，如果你在那个迷宫里迷路了，就会变成那里的魔物之一。

scripts.text: Kind of useless to be there without a partner but oh well.
scripts.translation: 没有伙伴在那里其实没什么用，不过也无所谓了。

scripts.text: It was a fun guild because no one took things seriously but master got tired of their laziness so he left.
scripts.translation: 那是一个很有趣的公会，因为没人把正事当回事，但师父受不了他们的懒惰，所以离开了。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Endless tower^000000 is somewhere in the sea. You have to find a guy named Jansor or Jans-something in Alberta and he'll sail you there.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000无尽之塔^000000在海上某处。你需要在艾尔贝塔找一个叫扬索尔（Jansor）或扬某某（Jans-something）的人，他会载你过去。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Ever since then he started being mean to weaker adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
从那以后，他开始对较弱的冒险者变得刻薄...

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
I don't think he ever saw that guild master again after that day.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我想在那天之后，他就再也没见过那位公会长了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
But he was also regarded as a troublemaker because of his competitive nature so he left.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
但因为他好胜的性格，也被视为一个麻烦制造者，所以他离开了。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please come back to me if you are received more kindness passes!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
如果您获得了更多的善意通行证，请回来找我！

scripts.text: Accept the request.
scripts.translation: 接受请求

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared the request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
完成请求后请通知我。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
The journey to the lowest floor of Glastheim is a long trip but it can be fun if you go with a party.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
前往格拉斯特海姆最底层的旅程很长，但如果和队伍一起走，会很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Gelkah]
You completed the request
^FF0000{0} Hunting^000000.
I will mark you down as having completed this request.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
您完成了请求
^FF0000{0} 狩猎^000000。
我会记录您已完成此请求。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
......

[Rohtert]
You are not even a member of Eden Group. What are you doing here?
I'm only dealing with base level ^FF0000100 - 110^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你甚至不是乐园团的成员。你在这里做什么？
我只接待基础等级^FF0000100 - 110^000000的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Yeah waddya want from me kid? You think I'm just gonna say ok I'll be your master and teach you everything I know?
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
喂，小孩，你想从我这里得到什么？你以为我会说“好的，我当你师父，把我所知道的一切都教给你”吗？

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You a new adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你是新来的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I used to an adventurer for the Eden Group just like you but of course I was the best.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我以前也是乐园团的冒险者，和你一样，但当然我是最强的。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Anyway, I'm doing this a favor to the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
总之，我做这件事是看在乐园团的面子上。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Okay ! You are doing the best that you can do.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
好吧！你已经尽力了。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You busy looking all around.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你一直在四处张望。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Such a novice... go and train yourself more. What? Don't like the way I talk? Then get stronger.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
真是个初心者... 去多训练一下吧。什么？不喜欢我说话的方式？那就变强点。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You are a little bit too mature of an adventurer. You have no business with me. Just leave. My business is with new third class adventurers up to level 110.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你作为一个冒险者太老练了。跟我没什么好谈的，走吧。我只负责指导基础等级110级以下的新晋三转冒险者。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
scripts.translation: [罗特特]

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I'm not a charity so get lost.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我不是慈善机构，快滚。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
There are so much things to do and you're wasting your time with me. Talk to Gelkah she's more chatty than I'll ever be to you.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我有那么多事要做，你却在这里浪费时间。去找盖尔卡吧，她比我话多多了。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You seem brave enough to be a good adventurer but you're nothing but a Novice in my eyes.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你看起来挺勇敢的，像个不错的冒险者，但在我眼里你只是个初心者。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I guess I'm retired now because my adventuring skills are just too good to compete with all you kids.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我想我现在算是退休了，因为我的冒险技巧太好，没法跟你们这些小鬼竞争。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I am looking for someone who regards friendship or loyalty like a Spoon Stub.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我在找那种把友谊或忠诚看得像老旧汤匙一样的人。

scripts.text: A Spoon what?
scripts.translation: 老旧汤匙？

scripts.text: You're a bad person.
scripts.translation: 你是个坏人。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You know? A Spoon Stub. Zombie Prisoners drop them and they seem like they're usefull but really they're kinda worthless.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你知道吗？老旧汤匙。腐尸战俘会掉落它，看起来很有用，但其实没什么价值。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Anyway, I guess you seem like the loyal type... sort of...
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
总之，我觉得你像是个忠诚的人... 大概吧...

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
That makes me feel weird. That is not bad but I guess I'm bad and I don't care.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
这让我感觉有点奇怪。这并不坏，但我猜我是个坏人，而且我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Remember to stay brave you silly adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
记住要保持勇敢，你这个愚蠢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I am afraid if you are becoming like Gelkah. She's like a lost puppy. Don't be like her. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我担心你会变得像盖尔卡那样。她就像只迷路的小狗。别像她那样，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I am done with my business.
I am responsible for clearing documents. I hate doing this stuff.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我的公务结束了。
我负责清理文件。我讨厌做这种事。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Tens Drillion I think we should teach it more lessons to show it who's boss!
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
Tens Drillion，我想我们应该教它更多教训，让它知道谁才是老大！

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Do you mind doing a simple errand?
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你介意帮我做个简单的跑腿任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Oh, how long has it been?
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
好久不见啊？

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
White is a paper and black is a letters. I hate public documents. But, I have to do this so I am busy for a while.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
白纸黑字，全是公文。我讨厌处理这些文件，但工作就是工作，我得忙一阵子了。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I know that hunting the Tens Drillion can't be too difficult for you.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我知道，猎杀Tens Drillion对你来说应该不难。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Good ! You are becoming a good adventurer! Do your best!
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
很好！你正在成为一名优秀的冒险者！加油！

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You still there novice? If you can't handle this by yourself then ask your friends because this is not the easiest thing to do.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你还在那儿站着，初心者？如果你一个人搞不定，就去找朋友帮忙，因为这可不是件容易的事。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Oh you're back safely!
I guess you're not a scrub like I thought you were.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
哦，你平安回来了！
看来你并不像我以为的那样是个菜鸟。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I guess I should talk to him one more time... Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我想我应该再和他谈谈...明天再来吧！

scripts.text: Lets give a good lesson for sure.
scripts.translation: 一定好好教训它一顿。

scripts.text: I think once is enough.
scripts.translation: 我觉得一次就够了。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
It is fine there are still many adventurers that can do this.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
没关系，还有很多冒险者能完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
It is not because I am coward.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
这并不是因为我胆小。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Good luck. Make sure you finish it off this time. Hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
祝你好运。这次一定要把它解决掉。哈哈！

scripts.text: No I don't mind!
scripts.translation: 不，我不介意！

scripts.text: Simple errands are for simpletons.
scripts.translation: 简单的跑腿任务适合简单的人。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You are a strange adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你是个奇怪的冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
One fine windy day, I was collecting flowers in west south of the Midgard Allied Forces Post to fulfill an Eden Group request.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
在一个刮着大风的日子里，我正在米德加尔特联合驻地的西南方采集花朵，以完成乐园团的委托。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Then that one suddenly showed up.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
然后那个东西突然出现了。

scripts.text: One what?
scripts.translation: 什么东西？

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
It was a ^FF0000Tens Drillion.^000000
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
那是一只^FF0000Tens Drillion。^000000

scripts.text:
[^FF0000Gelkah^000000]
Oops! Its actually ^FF0000Tendrilion^000000!! Master!
scripts.translation:
[^FF0000盖尔卡^000000]
哎呀！其实是^FF0000Tendrilion^000000！！师父！

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Yeah yeah potato po-tah-toh!
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
对对对，土豆，土豆！

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
We realized when we faced the eyes of the beast that it looked like a lion but it isn't any normal animal.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
当我们面对那野兽的眼睛时，我们发现它长得像狮子，但它绝不是普通的动物。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
^8008F8I knew that it was kill or be killed.^000000
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
^8008F8我知道那是非死即活的战斗。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
Of course I beat that beast easily! It was easier than taking candy from a Poring.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
当然，我轻松打败了那野兽！比从波利手里抢糖果还容易。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
But to my surprise, the beast got back up. I was forced to beat it down 12 more times before it stayed down. This was not a normal Tens Drillion.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
但令我惊讶的是，那野兽又站起来了。我不得不又把它打倒了12次，它才彻底倒下。这不是一只普通的Tens Drillion。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I heard it is still wandering place to palce but I am kind of busy now.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我听说它还在到处游荡，但我现在有点忙。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
I want you to take care of it. For me it was fine to be there alone. But for you.. I recommend you to bring more adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我想让你去处理它。对我来说，独自一人在那里没问题。但对你来说...我建议你多带几个冒险者。

scripts.text: You sure you did this yourself?
scripts.translation: 你确定是你自己做的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
The fact that I am strong is more important than the number. Just go there and take the beast out.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
我有多强比人数更重要。直接去那里把野兽解决掉吧。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You'll find it west of the Midgard Allied Forces Post at the Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你会在米德加尔特联合驻地的西边，Ash Vacuum找到它。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 看来我别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Rohtert]
You still there novice? If you can not handle by yourself then ask to your friends because it is not easy one.
scripts.translation:
[罗特特]
你还在那儿吗，初心者？如果你自己搞不定，就去找你的朋友，因为它并不简单。

scripts.text:
[^FF0000Gelkah^000000]
If you find it don't be scared. Master did not have to fight the Tendrilion 12 times.
scripts.translation:
[^FF0000盖尔卡^000000]
如果你找到它，别害怕。师父并没有和Tendrilion打12次。

scripts.text:
[^FF0000Gelkah^000000]
In fact, master was so drunk he barely remembers the thing.
scripts.translation:
[^FF0000盖尔卡^000000]
事实上，师父当时喝得太醉了，几乎不记得那件事了。

scripts.text:
[^FF0000Gelkah^000000]
I just left it alone because it was a little bit cute that a master was fighting with one Tendrilion. Now its becoming a problem.
scripts.translation:
[^FF0000盖尔卡^000000]
我只是把它留在那里，因为师父和一只Tendrilion打架的样子有点可爱。但现在它成了个问题。

scripts.text:
[^FF0000Gelkah^000000]
Please come back after clearing one Tendrilion. Oh and please keep this a secret from master.
scripts.translation:
[^FF0000盖尔卡^000000]
请解决一只Tendrilion后回来。哦，还有，请对师父保密。
